dialogues.speaker: Erinle
dialogues.text: Say no more. Make some time, go find a doctor, and get yourself a checkup.

dialogues.speaker: Erinle
dialogues.text: You might think I'm saying this just to scare you, but you probably don't know that many contestants only end up being told about major health issues just moments before they are supposed to compete.

dialogues.speaker: Erinle
dialogues.text: It's a real shame when minor, neglected illnesses turn into something more serious, ruining all that hard work they've put into training.

dialogues.speaker: Erinle
dialogues.text: And even if you're not a warrior, you still need to go for regular checkups!

dialogues.speaker: Erinle
dialogues.text: You should know, a person without health is no different from a tribe without people.
